Theme

how long? phrase

also how much longer?, how long (as far as when), how long is that good for?, how long is it valid?

classical

Traupman 87
Traupman 330

Quam diū?

Other words

  • 1Quoūsque: short final e (Lewis & Short quŏ-usquē). A compound of quō and usque, whose final vowel Lewis & Short itself marks short (usquĕ); the long mark under the compound stands alone. Traupman 330 prints quoūsque.

    Quoūsque?1 — how long? till when?

    also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 6.17: quoūsque humī dēfīxa tua mēns erit? (Lewis & Short); Plaut. As. 1.1.28 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 330

Examples

  • Quamdiū etiam?

    How much longer?Traupman 87

  • Quam diū valēbit?

    How long is that good for (valid)?Traupman 322

See also how long ago?, how soon?.
